decisions.evidenceBasis: The abstract reports four Mn bromide assemblies, light yield, X-ray charge collection and vitrification.
decisions.challengeReason: Four prepared materials are genuine examples but do not form organic substrate scope; performance comparison dominates.
decisions.evidenceSource: fresh paired compact title/abstract unless explicitly stated

decisions.title: Single Atoms Couple Molecular Coordination to Near‐Resonant Charge Transfer in Surface‐Enhanced Raman Scattering
decisions.reason: Single-atom-enabled SERS sensing is an analytical nanomaterial study.
decisions.evidenceBasis: The abstract reports Pt/Au/TiOx architecture, Raman enhancement and benzaldehyde gas detection via Schiff-base capture.
decisions.challengeReason: The capture reaction is a sensing step, not a general preparative method or product synthesis.
decisions.evidenceSource: fresh paired compact title/abstract unless explicitly stated

decisions.title: Sustainable Low‐Valent Iridium Active Sites in Rhenium Doped Perovskite Iridates for Efficient Acidic Oxygen Evolution Reaction via Hybridized Reaction Pathways
decisions.reason: Re-doped perovskite OER catalyst design and water-electrolysis performance are central.
decisions.evidenceBasis: The abstract focuses on Ir oxidation state, hybrid OER pathways, overpotential and catalyst durability.
decisions.challengeReason: No organic transformation or preparative product scope is present.
decisions.evidenceSource: fresh paired compact title/abstract unless explicitly stated

decisions.title: Synergistic Integration of Thermocatalysis and Electrocatalysis for Isopropanol Dehydrogenation Toward Efficient Hydrogen Production
decisions.reason: Thermo-electrocatalytic isopropanol dehydrogenation is framed and evidenced as hydrogen-production engineering with one model alcohol.
decisions.evidenceBasis: The abstract reports a RuIr HT-PEME, acetone/H2 production rates and catalyst stability at 200 °C.
decisions.challengeReason: The isopropanol-to-acetone reaction is real, but no transferable substrate scope is shown; the stated objective and evidence are a liquid-organic-hydrogen-carrier energy process.
decisions.evidenceSource: fresh paired compact title/abstract unless explicitly stated

decisions.title: Synergistic Vibrational Suppression and Aggregation Control via a Rigid Dimeric Acceptor for 21.13% Organic Solar Cells
decisions.reason: Molecular design for organic-solar-cell efficiency is primary.
decisions.evidenceBasis: The abstract reports one rigid dimeric acceptor, film formation, energy loss and photovoltaic efficiency.
decisions.challengeReason: Synthesis of an acceptor molecule supports device optimization; no general preparation route or product scope is established.
decisions.evidenceSource: fresh paired compact title/abstract unless explicitly stated

decisions.title: Ultrafast and High Charge Capability Aluminum‐Ion Storage With Long Term Stability
decisions.reason: Nickel-engineered Prussian-blue cathode for aluminum-ion storage, not organic synthesis.
decisions.evidenceBasis: The abstract centers on lattice distortion, Al-ion diffusion, charge rate and cycling retention.
decisions.challengeReason: Large-scale cathode production is materials preparation, not a general organic reaction or polymerization method.
decisions.evidenceSource: fresh paired compact title/abstract unless explicitly stated

decisions.title: Electrocatalytic Carbon Dioxide Reduction Coupled with Alcohol Oxidation
decisions.reason: Paired electrolysis may represent genuine organic electrosynthesis, but the obtained evidence still does not resolve the preparative contribution.
decisions.evidenceBasis: The fresh 17:13 compact still contains no abstract. The earlier publisher article/abstract/TOC attempts were bot-blocked, while a search excerpt only suggested cathodic CO2 valorization paired with anodic alcohol oxidation; no alcohol-product scope or preparative evidence was obtained.
decisions.challengeReason: Energy-related indexing is not enough to exclude a possibly genuine paired organic electrosynthesis, while the title and snippet are not enough to include it. The DOI remains individually deferred.
decisions.evidenceNeeded: Obtain the publisher abstract or relevant text/SI describing the alcohol substrates and oxidation products, the transferable preparative transformation, and scope or isolated-product/route evidence; distinguish this from an electrode/energy-performance-only study.
decisions.nextAction: Obtain textual publisher abstract or preparative sections showing alcohol substrates, products, scope and isolated/preparative evidence through the existing browser/VPN review path.

historicalScopeRechecks.evidenceBasis: The live Wiley article states an in-situ ATMS pre-activation strategy for a pyridylamido Hf catalyst and homogeneous polymerization of several sterically demanding α-olefins including 44DMP, 3MB and VCH.
historicalScopeRechecks.challengeReason: High melting temperature is an application/property outcome, but the article's explicit new catalyst-activation strategy unlocks polymerization across multiple difficult monomers. This is genuine polymer synthesis methodology under the contract, not merely property optimization.

historicalScopeRechecks.evidenceBasis: The ACS repository abstract now confirms protonation-controlled amino-BCB ring opening, a >50 kJ mol−1 barrier shift, >10^3-fold kinetic window and rapid [4+2] trapping, but gives no trapping-partner/product breadth.
historicalScopeRechecks.challengeReason: The work may be a useful reagent-activation method, yet the available abstract is dominated by kinetics and reactive-intermediate control. Without product/preparative scope, a final mechanism-only exclusion or method inclusion would both overclaim.
historicalScopeRechecks.evidenceNeeded: Trapping-partner scope, isolated cycloadducts/yields and whether stable ammonium precursors are applied as a general preparation platform.
historicalScopeRechecks.nextAction: Read the reaction/scope table through the existing browser/VPN path; retain the current card until resolved.
